news.title: Students, alumni earn national scholarships
news.summary_en: Iowa State University students and alumni are recognized nationally for several prestigious scholarships, including the Goldwater scholarship, National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship and Fulbright U.S. Student Program.

news.title: America’s last-mile delivery divide
news.summary_en: More than a decade of shopping data shows a clear divide in how Americans get their goods, an Iowa State researcher and co-authors report in a new study examining how demand for last-mile fulfillment services has evolved over time. This split can inform decisions such as where stores stay open and how companies prioritize investments in last-mile delivery.
